statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail is below the block threshold while rates, energy and geopolitical Stress remain extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains WATCH; the principal conditional hazard is the FOMC-minutes window and any delayed rates-to-equity repricing.
headline: Overnight downside follow-through moderates; FOMC minutes dominate the next risk window
body: Tuesday's technology-led selloff remains the backdrop, but early Wednesday U.S. and European futures are only slightly softer and the bond selloff has eased in Asia. Brent remains above $91 and Hormuz shipping uncertainty persists. Fresh independent NQ bar evidence does not confirm renewed persistent one-way extension.

lookbackSummary: Tail rose from WATCH into the low-30s during Tuesday's technology-led selloff, then retreated to the low-20s overnight as follow-through moderated and fresh one-way NQ structure was not verified.
outlookSummary: Stress remains extreme. Tail is modeled to stay below the block threshold through the morning, then rise conditionally into the FOMC-minutes and delayed-repricing window before decaying only if post-event price discovery is orderly.

forecast.analysis: The U.S. premarket transition can increase directional sensitivity after Tuesday's tech selloff. Without observed failed retracements, the forecast remains WATCH rather than a block.
Early U.S. premarket liquidity is a conditional checkpoint. Persistent technology weakness could raise Tail, while orderly retracements would support continued WATCH conditions.
Premarket participation and rates transmission become more informative. Tail stays conditional on whether NQ holds directional extremes and rejects meaningful pullbacks.
The U.S. cash-open hour begins at 15:30 Berlin. Opening-auction continuation would raise Tail, while two-sided price discovery and meaningful retracements would argue for lower risk.
EIA petroleum data arrive at 16:30 Berlin amid already elevated oil prices and Hormuz uncertainty. The event primarily raises Stress unless rates and NQ develop persistent aligned continuation.
Post-EIA interpretation is conditional. Stable oil, easing yields, or balanced NQ price discovery would reduce directional risk; renewed cross-asset alignment would keep Tail elevated.
Mid-session conditions are expected to depend on actual retracement quality. The forecast does not assume that Tuesday's technology weakness continues without fresh confirmation.
FOMC proximity begins to dominate. Tail rises to the top of WATCH because rates are already stressed and a later multi-stage policy interpretation remains a credible conditional mechanism.
FOMC minutes are scheduled for 20:00 Berlin. Tail moves into the elevated band because rates-to-equity repricing can be multi-stage; direction and persistence remain unobserved until the release.
The first post-minutes hour carries the highest conditional Tail. Bond-market reaction, NQ retracement quality, semiconductors and volatility must be assessed for a delayed second leg.
The cash-close hour remains conditionally elevated. Persistent post-minutes rate and equity alignment would sustain the block state; orderly retracement and stabilization would lower it.
CME equity-index maintenance reduces live price discovery. Tail falls to WATCH because new path evidence is unavailable, while residual post-FOMC Stress remains high.
Futures reopen after maintenance. Tail returns to the top of WATCH pending whether post-FOMC price discovery resumes directionally or shows meaningful mean reversion.
Late-evening futures trade is conditional on the quality of the reopening. Two-sided trade would support gradual Tail decay; renewed extension would delay normalization.
Overnight risk remains elevated but should decay if yields, oil and NQ stabilize. No future directional continuation is assumed.
Asia-opening conditions become the next cross-market checkpoint. Tail stays WATCH unless technology weakness and rates pressure re-align with persistent NQ extension.
Deeper overnight trade is modeled with lower Tail if no renewed one-way price path emerges. Stress remains high because rates and energy risks can re-amplify quickly.
Approaching the Asian morning, Tail remains WATCH under a stabilization scenario. A renewed gap or extreme-holding pattern would invalidate that decay path.
drivers: Asian morning gap and extreme-holding check

forecast.analysis: By the end of the 24-hour horizon, Tail returns to low only if post-FOMC trade has remained orderly and cross-asset pressure has not re-aligned into persistent Nasdaq continuation.
